entities.name: Audrey
entities.description: One of the two speakers; a city-dwelling dog owner who keeps four dogs (Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie), calls them her fur babies and her little family, and had a childhood dog called Max. She hikes, cooks, gardens, makes jewellery from recycled objects, and moved in June 2023 to a home with a bigger backyard. Long-standing friend of Andrew, whom she advises on dog ownership throughout 2023.

entities.name: Andrew
entities.description: The other speaker; a Financial Analyst who started that job in March 2023 and lives in an apartment in the city with his girlfriend. A keen hiker who feels most himself in nature and struggles with city life and work stress; he had no pets in March 2023 and acquired three dogs during 2023 — Toby, Buddy and Scout. Friend of Audrey.

entities.name: Andrew's girlfriend

properties.aliases: Andrew's girlfriend; his GF; my girl

entities.description: Andrew's partner, never named in the conversation but present throughout it: cafes and restaurants around town, a hike in May 2023, a picnic in July 2023, volunteering at a pet shelter, camping, a farm trip, fishing, a wine tasting, board games, a bike ride, and the beach trip planned with Toby.

entities.name: Pepper

properties.breed: mixed breed; called a Jack Russell mix in July 2023 and a Lab mix in October 2023

entities.description: One of Audrey's four dogs, with her since about 2020 alongside Precious and Panda. Took a while to accept the puppy Pixie in April 2023 and then became inseparable from her. Likes lounging on the couch.

entities.name: Precious

properties.breed: mixed breed; called a Chihuahua mix in October 2023

entities.description: One of Audrey's four dogs, with her since about 2020. Andrew took her to be the dog whose leash broke at the park on 22 September 2023. Has a chair she likes to rest on.

entities.name: Panda

properties.breed: mixed breed; called a Lab mix in October 2023

entities.description: One of Audrey's four dogs, with her since about 2020; referred to as 'he'. Relaxes on his own rug.

entities.name: Pixie

properties.breed: mixed breed; called a Chihuahua mix in October 2023

entities.description: The puppy Audrey's household adopted shortly before 2 April 2023, making four dogs. She took a few days to settle in with the others and curls up in her own bed.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: The activity that runs through the whole conversation. Andrew hikes to escape the city and calls nature a home for his soul; Audrey hikes with her dogs. They spent from July 2023 planning a hike together with the dogs.

entities.name: bird watching
entities.description: Andrew's long-standing interest — he is awed by birds, especially eagles, spots them while hiking and reads about ecosystems. In October 2023 Audrey said she wanted to take it up and they planned a birdwatching trip together.

entities.name: rock climbing
entities.description: Andrew took a rock climbing class with friends on Sunday 11 June 2023, reached the top and said he was hooked.

entities.name: Fox Hollow

properties.aliases: Fox Hollow; that hiking spot we talked about

entities.description: A hiking trail Andrew recommended to Audrey on 27 March 2023 as a good weekend walk with great views. She said she would try it but had not been by 2 April 2023 because of the new puppy.

entities.name: the park near Audrey's home

properties.aliases: the park; our local park; the park we usually walk

entities.description: The unnamed park Audrey walks her dogs in throughout the conversation — where she finds her centre, lets them off the leash, meets other owners, and where the leash broke on 22 September 2023 and where she had the accident that put her arm in a cast in October 2023. A dog park sits right beside it.

entities.name: the dog park near Audrey

properties.aliases: the dog park; the dog park nearby

entities.description: An unnamed dog park right beside the park Audrey usually walks in, with trees, benches, a big grassy area and shaded spots. She uses it for playdates, started agility classes there in August 2023, and took the dogs there on 30 September 2023.

entities.name: Audrey's dog tattoos
entities.description: Tattoos on Audrey's arm of her dogs. The first, of a dog and sunflowers, she already had by April 2023 and said it represents her love for her dogs and for nature; a second of all four dogs followed in August 2023 and further drawings were added in October 2023.

entities.name: Andrew's search for a dog and a dog-friendly home
entities.description: Andrew's running effort, from April 2023 onwards, to find both a dog to adopt and a place in the city that allows dogs — browsing websites, visiting shelters, asking friends, contacting landlords and checking neighbourhoods. He wanted somewhere near a park or woods. He brought Toby home in July 2023 and was still without a dog-friendly place in September 2023.

entities.name: the positive-reinforcement dog training course Audrey took

properties.aliases: the workshop about bonding with my pet; the positive reinforcement training class; the dog training course

entities.description: The training Audrey signed up for on seeing a flyer at her local pet store, announced on 11 May 2023 as a pet-bonding workshop for the following month and described on 3 July 2023 as a dog training course she was taking; the two mentions are joined here because the dates, subject and positive-reinforcement method agree. Challenging and a big time sink, but her dogs improved.

entities.name: Audrey's local pet store

properties.aliases: my local pet store; a pet store

entities.description: The pet store near Audrey. She saw the training workshop flyer there in May 2023 and met a volunteer's friendly dog; the shop where she bought her dogs toys on 16 October 2023 is recorded here as the same store, which the conversation implies but does not state.

entities.name: Audrey's new home

properties.aliases: my new place; the new house

entities.description: The house with a bigger backyard that Audrey moved into shortly before 26 June 2023. She set up a doggy play area with agility equipment and toys in the backyard, and was still unpacking boxes at the end of June.

entities.name: the lake in the mountains Audrey found on a hike

properties.aliases: this stunning lake in the mountains; a gorgeous lake in the mountains

entities.description: An unnamed mountain lake Audrey and friends came across on a hike a few years before 2023. She raised it twice — on 26 June and again on 24 August 2023 — as a memory of stillness and peace she has never forgotten.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: A hobby both speakers share. Audrey loves experimenting in the kitchen as an escape and for de-stressing, with garlic as her go-to ingredient, Chicken Pot Pie and Roasted Chicken as favourites; Andrew took it up by July 2023 because he could not get out hiking.

entities.name: Toby
entities.description: Andrew's first dog, a German Shepherd puppy he brought home shortly before 11 July 2023 despite living in the city. Too young to hike in September 2023; has a fluffy blanket as his favourite spot, loves sweaters, and once chased a squirrel round a tree at the dog park. Joined by Buddy in October and Scout in November 2023.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Audrey's childhood dog, an energetic dog who loved fetch. She took long walks around the neighbourhood with him as a child and confided her worries and hopes in him; she counts those days among her favourite memories.

entities.name: the pet shelter Andrew volunteered at
entities.description: An unnamed pet shelter where Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered on Monday 24 July 2023 and which he called one of the most rewarding things he had done. The shelter he adopted Buddy from in October 2023 is not stated to be the same one and is kept separate here.

entities.name: the dog agility classes Audrey attends
entities.description: Agility classes Audrey started with her four dogs at the dog park shortly before 4 August 2023, practising twice a week. She described it as tough at times, a physical and mental workout for the dogs, and a bonding experience.

entities.name: the hike Andrew and Audrey planned to take together with their dogs
entities.description: The outing the two friends kept arranging: agreed on 8 July 2023 for the following month, re-proposed by Andrew on 11 July, still spoken of as next month on 1 and 19 October 2023, and finally set for Saturday 28 October 2023 on a dog-friendly trail near a lake, with snacks and all the dogs.

entities.name: dog grooming
entities.description: The skill Audrey learned in August 2023 and now does herself: slow, gentle work with attention to ears and paws, plus daily brushing, regular baths and nail trims. She still used a pet salon in November 2023. Andrew said he had always wanted to learn it.

entities.name: the dog grooming course Audrey took
entities.description: The course Audrey took in August 2023, where she learned the grooming techniques she now uses on her four dogs herself.

entities.name: gardening
entities.description: Audrey keeps a small garden with Peruvian Lilies and a vegetable patch, which she finds relaxing and where her dogs run about; Andrew had been tending flowers on his balcony by September 2023.

entities.name: cycling
entities.description: Raised on 1 October 2023 by Andrew as a way to cut a carbon footprint, with routes near the river he offered to show Audrey, who usually takes public transport and wanted to try it. Andrew and his girlfriend rode out to a park outside town over the weekend of 28-29 October 2023.

entities.name: Audrey's knee injury
entities.description: A knee injury that stopped Audrey walking her dogs for a period before October 2023; she recalled it on 6 October 2023 and said getting back out with them felt great.

entities.name: Audrey's arm injury
entities.description: The injury from an accident while playing with her dogs at the park in the week before 24 October 2023, which left her arm in a cast and made handling four dogs one-handed tricky. She said she was feeling better each day.

entities.name: making jewellery from recycled objects
entities.description: Audrey makes one-of-a-kind jewellery out of bottle caps, buttons and broken jewellery. It began as a hobby, she now sells it, and she donates a portion of the profits to an animal shelter.

entities.name: the animal shelter Audrey donates to
entities.description: An unnamed animal shelter that receives a portion of the profits from Audrey's jewellery sales. On 6 October 2023 Andrew referred to her no longer being able to volunteer there, although on 27 July 2023 she had said she had never been to an animal shelter.

entities.name: Buddy
entities.description: Andrew's second dog, adopted from a shelter shortly before 19 October 2023 and named Buddy because he is Andrew's buddy and in the hope he and Toby would become buddies. He enjoys walks and new hiking trails and was still getting used to Toby.

entities.name: Scout
entities.description: Andrew's third dog, adopted shortly before 22 November 2023 and named Scout, after some deliberation, for his adventurous spirit. Kept on a leash outdoors at first, with a bed, toys and puppy pads set up as a safe space, and due to visit a nearby park with Toby and Buddy.

entities.name: the dog owners group Audrey joined
entities.description: A group of dog owners Audrey joined shortly before 4 November 2023 to learn how to look after her dogs better; she meets them about once a week for tips and so the dogs can play together.
